messages:
maria: FYI seeing controller-manager reconcile latency spike in eu-west1 ~10:03 UTC. GPU pods piling in Pending, allocator stuck on leader timeouts.

infra-bot: [ALERT] ctrlmgr_reconcile_latency > 1.2s (eu-west1) triggered 2023-11-03T10:03:19Z

sam: Can you grab controller-manager lease logs and etcd grpc errors? Sounds like leader flips.

jia: tailing logs now. repeating error: `failed to renew lease: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = transport is closing` every ~15s then `leaderelection: lock lost`.

oliver: Do we have any NAT or conntrack anomalies at that time? Past incidents showed conntrack exhaustion breaks grpc to etcd.

maria: checking NAT hosts in eu-west1  nf_conntrack_count 65290 / nf_conntrack_max 65536. Very near limit.

sam: That could cause transient gRPC failures and lease renew failures. Short-term mitigation: bump nf_conntrack_max and reduce leader churn by increasing lease durations.

jia: avoid noisy NAT rotation if possible. Patching controller-manager to extend lease/renewal now:
```
kubectl -n kube-system patch deployment kube-controller-manager --type=strategic -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"kube-controller-manager","command":["kube-controller-manager","--leader-elect","--leader-elect-lease-duration=60s","--leader-elect-renew-deadline=45s","--leader-elect-retry-period=10s"]}]}}}}'
```

oliver: I'm rolling a quick sysctl to NAT gateways: `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=131072` and bumping gc thresholds. Rolling to NAT fleet with a small rate limit.

maria: Patch applied. Controller-manager logs show renew attempts drop significantly; lock loss messages stop after ~30s. Pending GPU pods start scheduling.

deploy-bot: rollout status deployment/kube-controller-manager: 2 of 3 updated.

sam: Good. Root cause: why did conntrack climb? Any job fanout?

jia: NetworkFlow shows a large batch inference job at 10:02 creating many short TCP connections to an internal redis cache via NAT. High churn of short-lived outbound sessions, GC couldn't keep up.

oliver: Action items: 1) add conntrack new_entry rate alert and headroom metric; 2) tune NAT GC and default nf_conntrack_max per GPU-heavy regions; 3) investigate sticky outbound IPs / connection pooling for inference service to reduce NAT churn.

maria: Opening P1 ticket for eu-west1 NAT config + follow-up with product on inference connection patterns. Note: increasing leader lease is a temporary stability measure; long-term fix is network capacity/config or job change (cost tradeoff vs scaling NAT).

sam: Ops runbook update: if ctrlmgr reconcile latency spikes with lease renew failures -> check ectd grpc errors -> inspect NAT conntrack on gateway hosts -> if near max either bump nf_conntrack_max or throttle/rotate NAT.

jia: infra-bot reports cluster health recovered, Pending GPU pods cleared. I'll assemble a short postmortem and include perf histograms. :white_check_mark:

oliver: Thanks all. Also recommend sched/allocator keep a small emergency queue limit to avoid controller thrash during transient network saturation. "
